description.value: Oyster Express (OX) is a small, intimate oyster bar in Vancouver's historic Chinatown neighbourhood, specialising in freshly shucked, locally sourced British Columbia oysters served in a characterful atmosphere. It opened in 2012 and earned a wave of media coverage from the Vancouver Sun, Scout Magazine, cityfood, and several other local outlets. Touring cyclists riding through Chinatown would find a casual neighbourhood spot focused on Pacific oysters.
